items.title: KKR Makes $9 Billion Takeover Bid for Natural-Gas and Electricity Distributor
items.summary: Natural-gas and electricity distributor  UGI  recently received a roughly $9 billion takeover offer from  KKR  according to people familiar with the matter.  The private-equity firm offered to buy UGI for $42.50 a share, the people said.  It couldn’t be learned if UGI will be receptive and there are no guarantees of a sale to KKR or any other buyer, the people said.

items.title: Latest News In Energy Transition - Germany's Energy Future: From Mining Lands to Power Hubs
